Una nueva inundación repentina registrada en el centro de Nepal arrastró al menos 45 casas y dejó al menos 5 personas desaparecidas. El jefe de la Agencia Nacional de Desastres, Dharam Raj Uprety, explicó que la inundación se produjo porque el río había quedado bloqueado por un deslizamiento de tierra y, finalmente, se abrió una grieta, por lo que el agua comenzó a correr de repente. El país se recupera todavía del desastre provocado por el colapso de un glaciar a finales de agosto que dejó más de mil 400 muertos. #nmásunivisionviral #nepal #clima #inundación

Today, even the statue of Gautam Buddha was swept away by the devastating floods. A symbol of peace, compassion, and hope carried away by the force of nature. 💔🌊 This is not just a statue being washed away. It feels like a reminder of how powerless we can be when nature turns against us. Homes, roads, dreams, and now even symbols that have stood for peace for generations are being taken by the floodwaters, Nepal is hurting today. 🚨 A 6-year-old girl was rescued alive after spending approximately 55 to 60 hours trapped beneath flood debris in Timure, Rasuwa District, Nepal. Members of Nepal’s Armed Police Force worked through mud and wreckage before reaching the child, identified in reports as Manisha, and safely pulling her from the destruction. 🙏 The girl received immediate medical assistance and was reportedly transferred to Kathmandu for further care. videos.caption: Nepali rescuers are searching for missing people after flash floods swept away more than 200 houses and five bridges along the Budhi Gandaki river. Ninety-five people, including nine foreigners, were rescued on 11 October, while no deaths have been confirmed. Preliminary data suggests that a landslide dammed the river. It then burst, with the water surging downstream. Nepal is still recovering from devastating floods on 26 August, triggered by a mountain glacial collapse, which killed more than 1,400 people and left over 5,000 missing. 🎥 Sovit Shrestha, Nepal Army
